answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. A new agent docks at the wharf, posts a 50-unit bond, and earns a violet badge by proving compute. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of badges; a picked agent must answer in 30 seconds or forfeit bond and badge. A voyage through 10 epochs costs one identity 50 units and 10 proofs, so 100 fakes cost 5,000 units and 1,000 proofs. Honest agents pay once; a sybil farm pays 100 times over.
